faq.q1: Is DermaAsist a medical diagnosis tool?
faq.a1: No. DermaAsist provides AI-based skin assessments for informational and care-support purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for proper evaluation.
faq.q2: How accurate is the AI assessment?
faq.a2: The AI provides confidence levels with every assessment. Results should be treated as preliminary observations and not as definitive diagnoses. The accuracy depends on image quality, symptom information provided, and the AI model in use.
faq.a3: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption for data storage and transmission. Your health images and data are stored securely and are never shared without your explicit consent.
faq.q4: Can I use DermaAsist for my family?
faq.a4: Yes! You can create a family group and add up to 4 family members. Each member has their own profile with separate assessment history, images, and reminders.
faq.a5: Yes. DermaAsist supports both English and Hindi. You can switch languages from the navigation bar and all features, questionnaires, and reports are available in both languages.
faq.q6: What types of skin conditions can DermaAsist assess?
faq.a6: The AI can assess common skin conditions such as dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, fungal infections, acne, hives, and more. However, for any serious or rapidly worsening conditions, please seek immediate medical attention.
faq.q7: Can I share my assessment report with a doctor?
faq.a7: Yes. You can generate a PDF report of any assessment and share it with your healthcare provider for further evaluation.
faq.q8: Is the AI trained on Indian skin types?
faq.a8: The architecture supports AI models trained on Indian dermatology datasets. The model information, including dataset details and validation status, is available in the system. Please check the model information section for current details.
